lessons.title: Divided Minds: Hemispheric Specialization & The Corpus Callosum
lessons.description: Unpack anatomical asymmetries, the 200 million callosal fibers, left-hemisphere linguistic dominance, and right-hemisphere spatial mastery.

lessons.title: The Split-Brain Revolution: Sperry, Gazzaniga, & Dual Consciousness
lessons.description: Analyze tachistoscopic testing of surgical callosotomy patients, contralateral sensory pathways, and the left-hemisphere 'Interpreter'.

lessons.title: The Dynamic Brain: Structural vs. Functional Neuroplasticity
lessons.description: Demolish the dogma of the fixed adult brain: cross-modal sensory remapping, London taxi driver hippocampal growth, and phantom limb syndrome.

lessons.title: Synaptic Remodeling: Hebbian Plasticity, LTP, & Adult Neurogenesis
lessons.description: Explore molecular mechanisms of memory: Hebb's law, NMDA receptor coincidence detection, AMPA insertion, and neurogenesis in the dentate gyrus.
